crossRefs.note: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
to provide for those who mourn in Zion, to give to them a garland for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment…
But be glad and rejoice forever in that which I create; for, behold, I create Jerusalem to be a delight, and her people…
As one whom his mother comforts, so I will comfort you. You will be comforted in Jerusalem.”
You will see it, and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones will flourish like the tender grass. Yahweh’s hand will…
To you, Yahweh, I lift up my soul.
Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us.
Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should…

translations.web: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.
translations.bsb: Bring joy to Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
translations.kjv: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
translations.asv: Rejoice the soul of thy servant; For unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
